report_scope: diagnostic screening100; NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion
explicit_non_formal_statement: Fixed stratified 100-sample screening: a corrected-L2 / Prompt ablation signal only, NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion. It must not be quoted as the official CV-Bench accuracy of any approach.

primary_metric.rule: the only primary metric for every arm and every comparison

unweighted_metric.rule: secondary diagnostic only; never the CV-Bench primary and never decision-driving

prompt_plus_corrected_l2_integer.formula: accepted integer semantic Q0.15 + corrected patch L2 Q0.15, lambda=0.5

checks: 100 identical unique sample_ids across manifest and all six arms
no duplicate sample_id in any input
every new-arm record carries arm / budget=96 / region_grid=3 / cap=16
every non-bypass new-arm record emits K=96
selected_group_indices strictly ascending, length == K, hash re-verified
input grid identical across the three corrected-L2 arms

decision.reason: quantization gate passes (CI lower 0.000000 >= -0.02) and prompt_minus_integer_l2 CI lower 0.016667 > 0.0

limitations: Screening100 is a fixed diagnostic subset, not the formal 2638-sample benchmark.
Software Selector path only; no FPGA, latency or acceleration claim.
Dense and the two old selectors are descriptive references only and never drive the decision.
Forbidden primary metrics (pointing/grounding/ndcg/retained_mass) are never reported.
